definition.description: Apply the same safe file replacements/deletions to the synthetic target and run pytest directly under Python -I and the benchmark's allowlisted environment, without EvoGuard static policy.
definition.environment: the same allowlisted environment and disabled plugin autoload
definition.isolation: separate contained isolated-Python (-I) worker and disposable synthetic repository, run only after the Guard worker is cleaned up
definition.purpose: classification comparator, not a security boundary

corpus.format: canonical JSON (UTF-8, sorted keys, compact separators)
